title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Continuation of item 5) of the previous page. That page lists equivalent profinite ways of encoding a finitely generated field extension K/Q. Fix an algebraic closure Q̄ of Q and an embedding i of the algebraic closure of Q in K into Q̄. Then K is encoded by two pieces of data. The first is the outer profinite group π = π_1(K), the 'geometric' Galois group, i.e. the fundamental group of K⊗Q̄ (of the relevant factor). The second is the outer action on π of the open subgroup Γ_K ⊂ Γ = Gal(Q̄/Q) fixing i(alg. closure of Q in K). In the image, Γ_K is the open subgroup inserted parenthetically; the equation 'π_1(K)=Γ_K' in the transcription is a misreading.

Functoriality. A field homomorphism K → K' gives a homomorphism of outer groups π' → π (contravariant), defined up to inner automorphisms. By the general fact that morphisms between classifying topoi B_G → B_H of profinite groups correspond to outer homomorphisms (labelled (1)), the morphism of étale topoi B_{K'⊗Q̄} → B_{K⊗Q̄} is determined, up to unique isomorphism, by this outer homomorphism. Moreover the smaller group Γ_{K'} ⊂ Γ_K acts outerly on both π' and π, and π' → π is equivariant.

Reinterpretation. Such an outer action of Γ on π is the same as an 'outer extension' Σ of Γ by π, i.e. the arithmetic group in 1 → π → Σ → Γ → 1, essentially the absolute Galois group of K. Equivalently, up to rigid equivalence, it is the étale topos B_K over B_Q. The field map then corresponds to a homomorphism of (outer) extensions between Σ' and Σ over Γ, i.e. B_{K'} → B_K over B_Q.

This is the dictionary underlying birational anabelian geometry (the Galois-theoretic description of the category of finitely generated fields over Q). The following page goes on to strengthen it: trivial centralizers of open subgroups in Σ, and injectivity of Γ → Out(π).
errors: Directional slips: a field map K → K' gives Γ_{K'} ⊂ Γ_K, and a homomorphism of extensions Σ' → Σ. The page appears to write Γ_K ⊂ Γ_{K'} and Σ → Σ'; this may be a reading issue.

Recovering a genuine extension Σ from an outer action of Γ on π requires π to be center-free (or extra data). The page treats this as automatic; the next page addresses related centralizer questions. For K finite over Q, π = 1 and the description degenerates, as noted on the next page.
'image de π' dans π connue à automorphisme intérieur près' is imprecise: the homomorphism itself, not just its image, is defined up to inner automorphism.

ideas.what: Encoding a finitely generated field K/Q by the geometric outer Galois group π_1(K⊗Q̄) with an outer action of an open subgroup of Gal(Q̄/Q), i.e. the fundamental exact sequence and the outer Galois representation
ideas.modern_name: Outer Galois representation / fundamental exact sequence 1→π_1^{geom}→π_1^{arith}→G_k→1
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (SGA1 exact sequence; anabelian program in the 1983 letter to Faltings and Esquisse 1984)
ideas.where_published: SGA1 Exp. IX–X; Esquisse d'un programme; letter to Faltings (1983)

ideas.what: Morphisms of classifying topoi of profinite groups correspond to outer homomorphisms, so morphisms of étale topoi of fields are determined by outer homomorphisms
ideas.modern_name: B_G for profinite G; Hom(B_G,B_H) ≃ Hom_out(G,H)

ideas.what: Equivalence of viewpoints: outer action of Γ on π ↔ outer extension Σ of Γ by π ↔ étale topos B_K over B_Q, functorially in field maps
ideas.modern_name: Galois-theoretic description of the birational category / setup of the birational anabelian conjecture
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme; letter to Faltings

deep.surprise_reason: Standard foundational dictionary (outer groups ↔ extensions ↔ étale topoi over B_Q) that Grothendieck published in outline in the Esquisse and the Faltings letter. Nothing here goes beyond the known record; the more interesting claims (centralizers, injectivity of Γ→Out) are on the next page.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: not 'π_1(K)=Γ_K' as an identity. The reading is 'groupes profinis extérieurs π_1(K)', with an insertion '(un sous-groupe ouvert Γ_K ... de)' qualifying Γ_{Q̄|Q} as the acting group.
'à deux uniques près' is probably 'à iso unique près'.
Subscript in B_{K'⊗_K Q̄} is likely B_{K'⊗_Q Q̄}.
Marginal note at left reads roughly '... signifie que ... si K ⊂ Q̄ ...' (uncertain).
